author: Amy Kimmes
title: WJFW to host two debates in 7th Congressional District race - NewsBreak
text:
By Amy Kimmes ,
4 hours ago Wisconsin State Capitol Credit: bjphotographs - stock.adobe.com RHINELANDER — WJFW Newswatch 12 will host two live debates in July, featuring Republican and Democratic candidates, respectively, seeking to represent Wisconsin’s 7th Congressional District.
“Our goal is to provide a fair, informative forum that helps viewers compare the candidates’ ideas, priorities and leadership styles before they cast their ballots,” said Steve Shanks, WJFW general manager, in a news release.
The first debate, featuring Republican candidates, will take place from 5 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. July 7. Confirmed participants are Michael Alfonso, Jessi Ebben, and Niina Baum. Kevin Hermening has not committed to attending.
The second debate, featuring Democratic candidates, will be held from 5 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. July 14 . Confirmed participants are Chris Armstrong, Ginger Murray, and Fred Clark.
Both debates will be broadcast live on WJFW and will include a 10-minute intermission midway through the program. They will also be streamed on the Facebook page WJFW Newswatch 12.
Candidates will participate in opening and closing statements, answer questions from the moderator, and have opportunities to respond to issues raised during the discussion.
WJFW anchor Dan Hagen will serve as moderator for both debates.
“The last time Wisconsin’s 7th Congressional District held an open?seat election — with no incumbent on the ballot — was the special election in 2020,” said Geoff Weller, WJFW news director, in the release. “District 7 voters deserve clear answers on where each candidate stands on important issues. Two live, 90-minute debates will add clarity to this race.”
